[[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] '''Rajiss''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Chiss/Legends|Chiss]] [[Officer/Legends|officer]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]], stationed in [[Leth Outpost]] on [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]] during the [[Galactic War]] with the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].
